What could they be hiding from us?|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 ([[Cold Ambush]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Gatekeeper''' was a major boss that exclusively appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a high amount of health and a slightly slow speed. Unlike most other enemies in [[Cold Ambush]], it did not head to the exit, but instead walked around on the plots, similar to the [[Ripped Elf (Cold Ambush)|Ripped Elf]]. It had two abilities, the first one being ''Key Toss''. This ability made the '''Gatekeeper''' throw its large key at the towers. The key would travel in a circular direction, stunning towers hit by it before returning back to the '''Gatekeeper'''. The second ability, ''Key Hurl'', was similar to ''Key Toss''. However, instead of directly attacking towers with the key, the '''Gatekeeper''' would attack the Christmas tree with it, dealing 140 damage to the base as well as stunning any tower hit by the key. ==Appearance== The '''Gatekeeper''' had pale skin and large pointy ears. It wore a jester's uniform, with alternative red and green colors on its clothing, red pants and gloves, and a brown belt. It had a red and green four-way pointed hat on its head that drooped downward, with the bottom part of it being entirely made out of gold, which also had multiple red and green jewels attached to it. It wore a golden breastplate, pauldrons and shoes, as well as golden lining on its clothes and face. It wielded a very large gold key that it used to attack towers and the Christmas tree with. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Engineer]] are recommended against this enemy. **These towers should have their firerate and range boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] respectively. **The [[Ranger]] cannot be stunned by the '''Gatekeeper''', nor can the [[Engineer]]'s sentries be destroyed by it, making them both very effective. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse the stuns from towers stunned by the '''Gatekeeper's''' abilities. *Try to have as much base health as possible so that you have a higher chance of surviving the '''Gatekeeper's''' ''Key Hurl''. **Buying more plots increases your maximum base health and passive base health regeneration. ***If you avoid skipping waves, they will pass more slowly, giving you more time to passively regenerate base health this way. **The [[Medic]] can be used to heal back additional base health if the passive regeneration is not enough. *As the '''Gatekeeper''' does not try to reach the base, and its abilities are not affected by stunning towers, trying to slow it down is nearly useless. **The [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] cannot slow the '''Gatekeeper''' down due to its [[Freeze Immunity]]. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot slow the '''Gatekeeper''' down due to its poison immunity. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] are able to slow it down, but for a significantly lesser time due to the '''Gatekeeper's''' large size and the fact it is considered a major boss. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] can be used to reduce the '''Gatekeeper's''' defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Simulator- 🎄 Christmas Trailer 🎄|'''Gatekeeper''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *This is the first major boss to ever have defense. **While [[Wox the Fox]] does have defense with the [[Lost Souls]] modifier, this is due to it increasing the defense of all enemies by 20%; it does not have defense naturally and it is not a change made specifically to it. ==Update History== *'''21 December
